parsed.post: Huge win! DEPTH 8 with a new configuration reached 1.006960. It seems increasing the capacity while managing the learning rate and warmup is working. Since 1.0069 is our best, I'll now test if adding a small WEIGHT_DECAY helps further refine generalization.
parsed.description: Adding a small amount of weight decay to the current best configuration (DEPTH 8, MATRIX_LR 0.06, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 524288) to see if it improves generalization.
